name: Any language (generic profile)
status: Generic, language-independent checks only. Run make_profile.py to create a profile for the detected language, then have it reviewed by a native linguist.

how_to_fill: Run make_profile.py: it measures the script, punctuation, quotation marks and digits the project actually uses, and lists candidate minority spellings (rare variants of common words).
Claude drafts spelling, grammar, sandhi, register and punctuation rules for the language from its own knowledge and the project's style guide, if one is supplied.
A native linguist approves or edits every rule before the profile is used for a publishing check; the status field records that review.

figures_of_speech: Passive voice hiding the actor (divine passive)
